supporting_observations.claim: The supplied records show repeated connections from WS-BCARTER-01 to the explicit proxy at 10.30.20.30:8080 from 13:30 to 14:06 UTC, at roughly five-minute intervals. Several have similar byte counts, including about 5.8–6.0 KB sent and 30 KB received.
These periodic-looking flow records identify the proxy as the destination but do not identify the external HTTPS hostname or the originating workstation process.

OneDrive starts at 14:10, and shortly afterward Chrome makes successful SharePoint API requests through the proxy. This later activity does not establish the destination or purpose of the earlier periodic flows.
The cadence and relatively similar traffic volumes warrant investigation, but the available records do not distinguish an approved periodic updater from an unauthorized beacon.

known_telemetry_limitations: For the periodic flows, the supplied records contain Zeek connections to the proxy but no matching proxy CONNECT or request records identifying the external host.
The supplied periodic-flow records do not attribute the connections to a process; they therefore cannot be matched to ChartMate, a browser, or another application.
The records do not expose the encrypted traffic contents or explain what data was sent or received.
claims_not_established: That the periodic connections reached an unauthorized or malicious domain.
That the connections were generated by ChartMate or any other approved application.
That the traffic represents command-and-control, data exfiltration, or other malicious activity.
That the later OneDrive and SharePoint activity caused or explains the earlier periodic connections.
additional_evidence_needed: Proxy logs for the periodic timestamps, including CONNECT destinations, request metadata, and any available TLS inspection details.
Endpoint process-to-network telemetry for WS-BCARTER-01 covering the periodic connection times.
ChartMate updater execution, signature, configuration, and update-domain records for the review window.
Relevant DNS and firewall egress records to corroborate the external destinations and connection outcomes.
